proof_attempt_summary: Derived the compact-uniform original-record KM/Greenwood joint stable law, same-record feasible calibration, and software-horizon transition; broadened the model from C2 to the proved C1 class and resolved all three OEQs to existing theorems. The final referee capped novelty at incremental (6.3 below the field threshold 7.4) with no bounded in-scope salvage; the only math objection was independently cleared as an orientation-reversing coordinate-change false positive. Banking preserves discovery evidence only: no F-stage Lean proof certification, substrate promotion, or presentation was attempted, and unresolved historical priority and practical-coverage limitations remain.
tldr: The full-horizon causal RMST difference is identified when censor-survival vanishes as the fourth power of distance to a public endpoint, while the relevant classical variance integrals diverge. The focal result is a compact-uniform joint original-record limit for the literal KM contrast and its actual Greenwood sum over the entire prescribed unknown \(C^1\) hazard and censor-shape class. Predictable localization of the exact finite product yields the stable indices \(5/3\) and \(5/6\), their shared-jump dependence and an explicit characteristic--Laplace transform. Same-record endpoint learning and computable calibration give a total connected ninety-percent interval with expected length at most a public constant times \(n^{-2/5}\). The exact software horizon is centered at its random causal target; a derived terminal-area extension addresses the fixed target. This is a specialist technical limit-law and calibration result, with no field/flagship, sharp minimax or exhaustive-priority claim.
gap: Tian2020 Appendix A1 and Akritas2000CLTCensoring give finite-variance KM-integral theory, whereas the prescribed fourth-power endpoint makes their relevant moment integrals infinite.
